    right="Feat 5"
    pfs=""
>
[Reincarnated Ridiculer](/Feats.aspx?ID=5254) <actions string="" />
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="All Ancestries" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=467" />
<trait label="Reincarnated" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=783" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 80

</column>

---

You've practiced the art of taunting an enemy, ensuring they know death will only make you stronger. When you [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=2395) an opponent, the target doesn't become temporarily immune to your attempts to Demoralize it unless you critically fail the check. If the target critically hit you with a Strike on its previous turn, the DC for this check is reduced by 4.
